summary.intent: Finalize a pull request involving versioning changes by committing signed changes, merging main, pushing to the PR branch, and updating the PR's termination argument and supporting documentation.
summary.outcome: Signed commit ca954b025 was merged with main and pushed; the architecture doc (docs/architecture/versioning.md) was updated to add a reachability clause to the stop condition, doc-check was run, and the doc change was committed, merged with main, and pushed.

repo: The repo uses signed commits, and signatures are verified after pushing.
PR bodies contain a termination argument that must stay consistent with the architecture docs and specs.
A doc-check step exists and is run after architecture doc edits.
The PR branch needs main merged in before each push, which is done repeatedly.

code.finding: The stop condition in the versioning architecture doc was missing a reachability clause, which was added to align the doc with the PR's termination argument. Exact line numbers were not shown in the transcript.

workflow: Verify commit signatures and re-read the PR body after pushing to confirm the PR description matches the code and doc changes.
Run doc-check after editing docs before committing.
Merge main before each push to keep the PR branch current; the doc commit needed a second merge and push.

friction: The architecture doc fell out of sync with the PR's termination argument, requiring a follow-up commit after the initial push.
Merging main was needed twice in quick succession, adding extra push cycles.
